# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** At the time when the Divine Human was sent forth into spiritual combat, clothed in the first external truth animated by divine love, He gave that truth over against the first state of evil that exists — confront ing it through that single truth alone . By it He overcame the self hood, the very will toward spiritual death , together with all its derivative powers of falsity and evil.

**¶2 :** When the Divine Human rose up out of the deep est state of falsity, the Divine Operation brought forth the dominant ev ils and ruling falsities that had been subd ued — those things belonging to the realm of falsity — so that from them the spiritual order of the mind might be constructed and everything arranged according to what is fitting for the Divine Goodness. From that time on ward, the reservoirs in which falsities and evils had been stored were broken open , destroyed , and laid waste, along with everything that had been contained within them.

** ¶3:** Just as in a confused state where truths and falsities are mingled together , the living affections and active thoughts are caught and drawn out by means of disc ernment, while only resid ual natural appearances and the lowest grow ths of the sens ory mind remain behind — so it is with the reservoirs of spiritual death. The Divine Human drew out their deliberate intentions and their affiliated evils that dw elt within them, and the empty containing forms were left behind in their place.

**¶4:** Such , then, is the condition of the entire realm of falsity, and of the reservoirs of evil that were within it.

**¶5 :** Just as the human form contains many members within it, so the realm of falsity poss esses reservoirs of evil from its very origin — all derivative evils depending from the one dominant ruling love as members hang from the head of a body . A single origin is the origin of them all, because every fals ity and every subordin ate evil derives from and is sustained by the one ruling self -love that presides over the whole . If some lesser evil is separated from the ou termost extensions of these subordin ate ruling loves , the dominant ruling love that gov erns them all remains in its place, unchanged — one finds that this death of the spirit is still alive . All the subordinate ruling loves are firmly rooted in it .

**¶6:** When , however, all the subordinate evils are sev ered from it — all these lesser ruling loves become as dead forms, because they can no longer see or act ; they lose their hold upon the organized whole of evil to which they had been joined.

* [ This paragraph is heavily fragment ary. The translation above represents my best reading : that derivative evils, once sev ered from the ruling love that animates them, become in ert — spiritual corp ses without will or agency . ]*

**¶7:** In precisely this way, the reservoirs of falsity function : they are the sources from which all falsity poured forth into the mind .

---

** Translator 's note on the governing image :** The entire chapter teaches that the realm of falsity in the human mind is not a chaos but an * organized body * — a count erfeit form held together by a single dominant self -love ( the "great head"). The Divine Human's combat does not ann ihilate this body all at once but draws out its active intentions and living ev ils, leaving behind empty containing forms. The profound teaching is that subordin ate fals ities, sev ered from the ruling love, become inert, while the ruling love itself pers ists until it too is finally overcome . This corresponds exactly to Swedenborg's teaching that ev ils are removed not by destruction but by separation and re -ordering , and that the ruling love is the last thing to yield .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: At the time when the First Man was sent to the war in the first garment of [living fire], which he gave to the first nature that exists [, and he opposed it] in that single garment. [With it] he hunted Matter, the thought of Death, [its counsels,] and all its other powers.

When the First Man came up from the abyss, [then] the Living Spirit brought the rulers whom he had hunted [from every] element, that [are] of [the land of] Darkness, that he might construct from them this universe and fashion everything appropriate for the Greatness. From that time on, the place of the storehouses of the elements [was broken open, and] he destroyed and laid waste the [storehouses and] all that were in it.

Just like a marsh, of which the fish and birds are snared in a net, and only the waters are left behind and the reeds and the plants that grow in it, this is also the case with the storehouses of Death. The [First] Man snared their counsels and [their k]in that were [in them], and the storehouses were left behind in their [dwelli]ng place.
So then, the case of the land of Darkness is like this, as is that of the storehouses that were in it.
In exactly this way, it is also the case that the storehouses of Darkness are the same, the things from which the [Darkness gushed] forth.

Just as the body of man has many limbs in it, [the land of Darkness] has [storehouses from] its beginning [...] all [the limbs] that hang from the great head of the [body]. A single root is the root of them all, because they all hang from the great head that is on top of the body. Should a limb be cut from the tip of [the]se small [h]eads, the great head that is on top of them [al]l stays in its place the way that it is [...] you find this person alive. Al[l] these sm[all h]eads are firmly set in it [...]
